name: National Real Estate Development & Investments SAOG
description: National Real Estate Development & Investments Company SAOG is an Omani real estate development and property investment company listed on the Muscat Stock Exchange Parallel Market. Following consecutive annual losses in FY2023 and FY2024, the company returned to profitability in FY2025 (OMR 0.61M net income on OMR 0.49M revenue) and accelerated earnings recovery through the first nine months of 2026. Its condensed interim filings report standalone profitability figures without property-level or operating segment disaggregation.
highlights: Delivered an unaudited 9M 2026 net profit of OMR 579,541, nearly eight times the OMR 72,926 net profit recorded in the corresponding period of 2025.
Sustained its earnings turnaround following FY2025 full-year net profit of OMR 0.61M after net losses of OMR 2.02M in FY2023 and OMR 2.19M in FY2024.
FY2025 Financial Snapshot: Revenue of OMR 488.3K and Net Profit of OMR 611.7K (Total Assets: OMR 3.06M).
Ownership Registry (mcd.om): 137 registered shareholders • Omani 90.2% | GCC 9.6% | Foreign & Arab 0.2% (6 disclosed 5%+ holders).
